p.i: Quoniam superior Currus triumphalis & Porta Honoris in gloriosissimi Diva memoria Pr. Maximiliani I. Imp. augu-stiss.laudem & honorem effecta & depicta, descriptaq; fuerunt: in iisq; pleraque ipsius Majestatis res summa cum laude, virtute, felicitate, & totius mundi admiratione gesta breviter attinguntur: non alienum à praesenti opusculo fore existimavimus, si eiusdem Majestatis Epitaphium verè Im-

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Entry "18." first name printed as "Cinhard", read as Einhard with doubt. The degree in "r.grad." is unclear and may be another numeral. Lines of the column blocks are set as separate lines and may not match exact column breaks. "Auff den zwo kleinen Seulen" is set in larger type, so it is treated as a level 3 heading. The running head reads "Keys. Maximiliani I." with a dagger-like mark after I, read as a period. The catchword "pera-" and signature "O 5" are at the foot. The paragraph continues on the next page.
